PRIMARY_RESEARCH_QUESTION.en: Do xG / Shots / SOT contain predictive information incremental to the frozen H2 attack/defence goal-rate structure, rather than mostly re-expressing the same underlying team strength?
PRIMARY_RESEARCH_QUESTION.ko: H2가 이미 설명하는 팀 강도 성분을 분리한 뒤에도 과거 공격 과정 데이터에 추가적인 1X2 probability signal이 남는가?

observations: All Phase-1 candidates improved 2024 LL/Brier versus v1.
Versus H2: EPL F1/F2/F3 improved; La Liga F2/F3 improved while F1 worsened; Serie A and Bundesliga all worsened.
High fitted covariate correlation; H2 information overlap PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED.
Coefficient movement/sign reversal and correction magnitude alone do not explain success/failure.
PRIOR_EVIDENCE.interpretation: Motivation only; no expected performance target, candidate selection, causal proof, or winner declaration. Phase-1 evidence was already exposed before V3.1 registration.

FEATURE_SCOPE.purpose: Representation and incremental information, not feature expansion

UNDECIDED: Exact fitting and representation training procedure
Logical Phase-1 reference mapping per candidate
REQUIRED_PROPERTIES: Frozen H2 backbone estimator/source unchanged; official Forward remains v1.
Exclude target own statistics and target results from prediction input.
Exclude market/odds/provider predictions and owner/external shadow inputs.
Same-league temporal isolation for every learned representation, parameter and target input.
Mathematically explain the claimed information distinction from H2; decorrelation alone is not proof of incremental predictive signal.
One algorithm specification per registered candidate applied identically to all four leagues; no outcome-tailored league formula.
League-specific fitting may be allowed by future design, not selected here.

COMPARATORS.referenceOnly: Corresponding frozen V3 Phase-1 candidate only when logically comparable; mapping/rationale preregistered before V3.1 results, otherwise mark NOT_APPLICABLE. No forced R1/F1 or R2/F2 mapping.
COMPARATORS.reporting: Each league/candidate separately; paired IDs, denominator, coverage, PASS and missingness preserved; no pooled winner score.

DEVELOPMENT_SPLIT.scope: Existing four-league Regular Season cohort; no outcome-based cohort repair.
DEVELOPMENT_SPLIT.exposureDisclosure: Prior Phase-1 2024 results informed these research questions. This is preregistration before V3.1 results, not a claim that 2024 is unexposed.

evaluationPrerequisites: Numeric promotion rule resealed before holdout access
Independent integrity/exposure validation and separate explicit CTO approval

DRAW_FIREWALL.purpose: Incremental attacking-process signal; DRAW behavior monitored descriptively, no DRAW repair.

METRICS.interpretation: Report both comparators separately. Correlation, ECE and proper scores address different properties. Exact execution conventions must be frozen before execution, not selected after results.

SUCCESS_QUESTIONS: Has information overlap with H2 decreased?
Has cross-league heterogeneity in feature-effect direction decreased?
Are LL/Brier improvements versus H2 more consistent than Phase-1?

prerequisites: Frozen implementation, comparators, input and beta hashes
All four leagues evaluated once without rerun or tuning
existingRuleReadOnly.primary: Per candidate, every league, and each comparator separately: delta LL < -1e-12 AND delta multiclass Brier < -1e-12.
existingRuleReadOnly.classGuards: Every HOME/DRAW/AWAY versus each comparator on the fixed primary population: recall delta >= -0.05-1e-12; ECE delta <= 0.01+1e-12; one-vs-rest Brier delta <= 1e-12.
existingRuleReadOnly.coverage: Fixed comparator intersection U contains at least 100 fixtures and >=80% of full league cohort; candidate predicts 100% of U; all full-cohort IDs retained; zero FAIL/INVALID; all three actual classes present in U.
existingRuleReadOnly.nullHandling: Null required recall/ECE or missing primary probabilities => INSUFFICIENT, never silently pass. Precision null is reported, not a promotion guard.
existingRuleReadOnly.outcome: ELIGIBLE_FOR_CTO_PROMOTION_REVIEW only if all four leagues pass all gates; otherwise SCREEN_NO, INSUFFICIENT, FAIL or INVALID as applicable. No model promotion or automatic Forward migration.
existingRuleReadOnly.multipleCandidates: Evaluate all F1/F2/F3 separately; no composite winner, league cherry-picking, unregistered ensemble or automatic choice among passing candidates.
existingRuleReadOnly.exposed2024: DESCRIPTIVE_CHECK_ONLY; report numeric metrics and differences, no promotion eligibility from these data
existingRuleReadOnly.rationale: Fixed conservative descriptive eligibility guardrails, not a significance test: common denominators, both probability scores improve, class recall capped at 5 percentage-point loss and ECE at 1 point. No claim that these constants were empirically optimized.

PROMOTION_GOVERNANCE.v31RuleDecision: DEFERRED: reuse unchanged or make stricter at V3.1 Design Freeze; no weakening or automatic discard.
PROMOTION_GOVERNANCE.note: The copied F1/F2/F3 enumeration is historical evidence, not authorization for three V3.1 candidates. V3.1 limit is two; all registered candidates must follow the presealed rule.

FEATURE_SELECTION_FIREWALL.possibleReduction: Only a documented Phase-1 redundancy rationale and preregistered protocol reasoning, resolved before Algorithm Design Freeze; no selection made here.

TEMPORAL_AND_PROVENANCE.historicalRole: Retrospective final/revised evidence; strictReplayEligible=false; no fabricated observedAt.
TEMPORAL_AND_PROVENANCE.priorPhase1Contract: Read-only historical reference. V3.1 exact representation/fitting/availability/missingness details must be explicitly resolved in Design Freeze; no silent algorithm inheritance.

RIGHTS.source: Prior provider dashboard Chat AI guidance relayed by user; not upgraded by this protocol.

preservation.verification: Canonical evidence hashes and source/dependency/protected byte hashes verified before/after; no local holdout raw accessed.
